theme_central: What is true is recognized by its solidity, what is false by its fragility — shown through the signs of creation and the parables of water and molten metal.
sources_note: Division into 7 sections precisely sourced (alim.org / quran-wiki.com, Overview Surah 13).

branches.title: Truth of revelation, signs of creation
branches.resume: The heavens raised without pillars, the earth spread out, fruits in pairs.

children.t: The heavens without pillars, the sun and moon on their orbits, the earth spread out

branches.title: Disbelief, arrogance
branches.resume: Astonishment at doubting the resurrection, a hasty demand for punishment.

children.t: Astonishment at doubting the resurrection, hastily demanding a sign

branches.title: Allah's knowledge, power and mastery
branches.resume: Allah knows every pregnancy, every hidden thought; the thunder glorifies Him.

children.t: Allah's omniscience, the thunder and the angels glorify Him

branches.title: Truth versus falsehood
branches.resume: Parables of the water that carries foam and of molten metal: only what is useful remains.

children.t: Parables of water and molten metal: what is useful remains, the rest evaporates

branches.title: Believers and disbelievers: traits and fate
branches.resume: Those who honour their commitments to Allah versus those who break them; tranquillity through the remembrance of Allah.

children.t: Traits of those of understanding: honouring commitments, patience, prayer
The fate of those who break the covenant; tranquillity through the remembrance of Allah

branches.title: The Prophet's mission
branches.resume: The people's reactions to the Qur'an, comparison with previous nations.

children.t: Reactions to the message, comparison with the rejection of previous nations

branches.title: Allah's absolute authority
branches.resume: Allah erases and confirms what He wills; closing on Allah as a sufficient witness.

children.t: Allah erases and confirms what He wills; Allah suffices as a witness
